sentences.text: The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Neethi B.T..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 19-02-2017.
CW4 had given gold ornaments to CW-1 and to Accused No.1 and performed the marriage.

After the marriage,
CW-1 started residing with Accused No.1 and 2 .
At that time, the Accused No.2 was not providing food to CW-1 and CW-1 was doing household work before going to office.
Accused No.1 forced CW-1 to go for job and to give salary to them.
During the year Feb,2020 CW-1 begot a female child for which Accused used to harass CW-1.

When CW-1 came to know about extra marital affairs of Accused No.1, the Accused No.1 threatened to kill her stating not to disclose  3  C.C.No.38626/2022 with anybody, CW-1 left to her parents, Accused No.1 followed her and picked up quarrel with CW 1, 4 and 5 and thus subjected CW- 1 to cruelty both physically and mentally in demand of dowry .
Based on the information of Smt.Neethi B.T.. a case in Cr.No.263/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court Smt Neethi vs Chaithanya Kumar N Gowda on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198402580/
2 took cognizance of the alleged offences.

sentences.text: Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC. & Sec.4 of D.P. Act.?
 2) what order?

sentences.text:
My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS
9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
 5  C.C.No.38626/2022 the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex. P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Neethi.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 19-02-2017 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2

and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2. The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her. During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and Smt Neethi vs Chaithanya Kumar N Gowda on 1 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198402580/
4 denied all other suggestions.

sentences.text: On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness  6  C.C.No.38626/2022 have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER

In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 of IPC.
& Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.

(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on the computer and print out taken by her is verified, corrected & then pronounced by me in the Open Court dated this the 01-02-2025).
(SYED ARFATH IBRAHIM M.) XXXVII ACJM., BENGALURU.
